title: Reports of Anthropic hiring ex-Google TPU chief Amir Salek
reason: Bloomberg (Dina Bass, 2026-08-21) reported Anthropic hired Amir Salek, formerly head of Google's Custom Silicon/TPU program (departed Google March 2022 for Cerberus Capital Management), to its compute/chip team. Wire-exclusive check run per policy/verification.md §2: only Bloomberg has this; Seeking Alpha's coverage explicitly relays it ('according to Bloomberg'), and a targeted search excluding bloomberg.com found no other outlet reporting the hire itself. Direct fetch of Bloomberg blocked (403/paywall); confirmed only via search snippets and the Seeking Alpha relay. Salek's Google TPU background is independently confirmed (Wikipedia citing FT and his own departure post, a contemporaneous 2022 Businesswire release on his move to Cerberus) but that is biography, not today's hire claim. Anthropic's broader in-house chip ambitions are independently multi-sourced since April 2026 (Reuters, The Information, TechCrunch, Forbes) but that is separate, already-established context, not confirmation of today's specific hire. Per the business-claim standard (>=2 independent Tier<=2 sources, or a filing), this does not clear the bar to publish as confirmed -- holding for a second independent outlet.
watch: A second independent Tier <=2 outlet (not relaying Bloomberg) reporting the Salek hire specifically
